title_original: Art Dhaka to launch inaugural edition
excerpt_original: The fair will have its inaugural edition from 6–10 November at Aloki in Dhaka

blocks.text: Art Dhaka, a new fair bringing together traditional, modern and contemporary art founded by Durjoy Rahman, Fahd Sattar, Nahar Khan, and T. Aumia Khundkar, will have its inaugural edition from 6–10 November at Aloki in Dhaka.

The artists Najmun Nahar Keya and Zihan Karim will lead the curatorial direction of the fair. A dedicated print pavilion will be curated by the artist Fareha Zeba. A series of exhibitions, events and panel talks discussing the arts and culture landscape in Bangladesh will also take place throughout the week alongside the main fair.
